openspec/changes/gpu-session-baseline-and-idle-reclaim task 1.1: read-only GPU session baseline measurement (nvidia-smi + coordinator health probe + environment fingerprint). Not deploy.ps1/verify-all.ps1 (it measures, it does not deploy or gate); not scripts/lib (it is the operator-invoked CLI entry, repeatable by design); not scripts/tests or tests/e2e (it is not a pass/fail check, it produces a JSON report). Core logic lives in scripts/lib/measure-session-baseline.ps1; unit/fail-safe/registry tests in scripts/tests/test-measure-session-baseline.ps1. Never opens a WebRTC session or starts/stops a service.
